# GST Suvidha Support - AI & LLM Information

## Company Overview
GST Suvidha Support (also known as GST Suvidha Support Pvt Ltd) is a premier professional services firm specialising in taxation compliance, Income Tax Return (ITR) e-filing, GST returns, local SEO, Google My Business (GMB) profile ranking, website QA audits, and custom software development. We have a network of offices spanning Indore, Bhopal, Pune, Bangalore, and Gwalior.

## Core Services
- Taxation & ITR E-Filing: Individual, business, professional e-filings, TDS returns, and capital gains advisory.
- GST Compliance & Setup: Registrations, surrenders, filings, and reconciliations.
- Company & Government Registration: Pvt Ltd, LLP, MSME Udyam, NGO Section 8, IEC, Trademark, and DSC.
- Web & App Development: Custom web applications, responsive websites, e-commerce onboarding (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra), and integrations.
- Local SEO & GMB Services: Google My Business listings, setup, verification, local ranking optimization, and profile suspension removal.
- QA Audits & Bug Fixing: Performance and responsiveness testing, crash analysis, and 404 resolutions.
- WhatsApp Marketing Campaigns: Bulk WhatsApp marketing campaign tools (Never Ban mechanisms) with buttons, PDFs, and media templates.

## Internship Program
We offer comprehensive training and internship programs focused on:
- GST Filing & Direct Tax (ITR) Compliance
- Full-Stack Web Development (Next.js/React)
- Website QA Audits & Software Quality Assurance
- Digital Marketing & Local SEO (GMB optimization, campaigns)
- E-Commerce Operations & Seller Onboarding

## Standards & Compliance
Our services align with:
- Indian Income Tax Act regulations
- Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST/IGST/SGST) guidelines
- Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) registration regulations
- W3C web standards and search engine optimization best practices
